judgment.notes: N001 applies to E⊆Eucl(n) with q>D≥0, and to F⊆Eucl(n+1) with exponents a>1 or q+1>0. N002 supplies finiteness and nonnegativity of D. All ball, power, series and infimum facts have their actual local conditions verified in BG001–BG007. There are no E/M applications.
